tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.empty: No tenants yet. Create the first organization.
tenants.firstSupervisorHint: This person signs in first and sets up the organization's users, categories and locations.

fields.codeHint: A short ID such as riyadh-hospital. It can't be changed later.
fields.name: Name

statusNote.Suspended: Suspended: its users can't sign in, and anyone signed in was signed out. Data is kept.
statusNote.Archived: Archived: hidden from the normal list and no one can sign in. All data is kept.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.message: Its users are signed out right away and can't sign in until you reactivate it. No data is removed.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.message: Its users are signed out and can't sign in, and it is hidden from the normal list. All data is kept and you can unarchive it later.

users.title: Users
users.deletedNote: Deleted users can't sign in and are hidden from their organization. Their email and username stay reserved. Restore brings a user back as active.
users.search: Search by name, username or email
users.roleHint: A new role signs the user out of every session, so their next sign-in uses it. An organization always keeps at least one active supervisor.

roleConfirm.title: Make this user a {{role}}?
roleConfirm.message: They are signed out everywhere and sign in again with the new role.

users.setPasswordNote: For a forgotten password. The user is signed out everywhere and signs in with this password.
users.passwordSet: New password set. Give it to the user now.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.message: They are signed out right away and can't sign in until reactivated. They stay in the user list.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message: They are signed out and hidden from their organization. Their history stays. You can restore them from Deleted users.
